test.title: A garden that needs less water

texts.title: A garden that needs less water

paragraphs.text: Hotter summers and bans on using hosepipes have led many gardeners to rethink the way they grow plants. A garden that needs less water can still be attractive, but it requires some planning.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: Choosing the right plants is the most important decision. Plants from dry regions, such as lavender and rosemary, have small or silver leaves that lose little moisture and can survive weeks without rain once established.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: The soil itself can hold more water if it is improved. Adding compost helps sandy soil to keep moisture, and a thick layer of bark or gravel on the surface reduces evaporation.
paragraphs.label: C

paragraphs.text: When watering is necessary, timing makes a difference. Watering early in the morning or in the evening means less water is lost to the sun, and a thorough soak once a week encourages deeper roots than a light daily sprinkle.
paragraphs.label: D

paragraphs.text: Many gardeners also collect rainwater. A simple container connected to a roof gutter can store hundreds of litres over the winter, providing a free supply for the driest months.
paragraphs.label: E

document.title: A garden that needs less water

items.quote: Hotter summers and bans on using hosepipes have led many gardeners to rethink the way they grow plants

explanation.en: Heat and hosepipe bans “have led many gardeners to rethink” — the reasons for change → iv.
explanation.kk: Ыстық пен шлангқа тыйым «have led many gardeners to rethink» — өзгерістің себептері → iv.
explanation.ru: Жара и запреты на шланги «have led many gardeners to rethink» — причины перемен → iv.

items.quote: can survive weeks without rain once established

explanation.en: Plants from dry regions “can survive weeks without rain” → v “Plants that cope with dry conditions”.
explanation.kk: Құрғақ өңірдің өсімдіктері «can survive weeks without rain» → v «Plants that cope with dry conditions».
explanation.ru: Растения из сухих регионов «can survive weeks without rain» → v «Plants that cope with dry conditions».

items.quote: The soil itself can hold more water if it is improved

explanation.en: Paragraph C is about improving the soil so it holds water: “The soil itself can hold more water”, then compost and bark → i “Making the ground hold moisture”.
explanation.kk: C абзацы топырақты ылғал ұстайтындай қалай жақсарту туралы: «The soil itself can hold more water», әрі қарай компост пен қабық қабаты → i «Making the ground hold moisture».
explanation.ru: Абзац C о том, как улучшить почву, чтобы она держала воду: «The soil itself can hold more water», дальше компост и слой коры → i «Making the ground hold moisture».

items.quote: When watering is necessary, timing makes a difference

explanation.en: When to water (morning, evening) and how (a weekly soak) → iii “When and how to water”.
explanation.kk: Қашан суару (таңертең, кешке) және қалай (аптасына бір рет мол) → iii «When and how to water».
explanation.ru: Когда поливать (утром, вечером) и как (раз в неделю обильно) → iii «When and how to water».

items.quote: A simple container connected to a roof gutter can store hundreds of litres

explanation.en: Rainwater from the roof is stored in a container → ii. “Free supply” tempts you to vii about bills, but the topic is storing rainwater.
explanation.kk: Шатырдан аққан жаңбыр суы ыдысқа жиналады → ii. «Free supply» су ақысы туралы vii-ні таңдатады, бірақ тақырып — жаңбыр суын сақтау.
explanation.ru: Дождевая вода с крыши собирается в бак → ii. «Free supply» провоцирует vii про счета за воду, но тема — хранение дождевой воды.
